title: SAML assertion entropy audit and RBAC delegation acceptance checklist
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: This ticket captures the product-level acceptance criteria, testing plan, and sign-off checklist for a bundled set of security controls required for Private/VPC deployments: SAML assertion entropy and freshness checks, RBAC delegation patterns for operator roles, cryptographic provisioning to KMS/HSM, and structured audit evidence capture. The goal is to produce an operationally-testable acceptance package that the security review board and sales engineering can use during customer onboarding.
acceptance_criteria: SAML assertions must contain nonce and issuance timestamps; verification logic rejects assertions older than configured freshness window (default 120s).
Assertion entropy/uniqueness metric: end-to-end tests produce collision rate < 1e-9 across 1M assertions synthetic test.
RBAC delegation model implemented: operator roles, customer-admin roles, read-only observer role; policies documented and enforced via attribute-based checks.
KMS/HSM provisioning flow: customer KMS keys accepted via wrapped-key import or HSM attestation; keys are never exported in plaintext from customer environment.
Audit logs include structured entries for SAML events, RBAC grants/revokes, key import/rotation, and operator sessions with immutable timestamp and request ID.
Automated evidence bundle generation: given a customer onboarding ID, the system can generate a zip containing the required log snippets, config snapshots, and test artifacts within 30 minutes.
Security review required and completed with findings tracked; any P0 findings must be remediated before production signoff.
scope_changes: Initial PRD specified basic SAML validation; scope expanded to include entropy/collision testing and automated evidence packaging (requested by Sales/SE).
RBAC model expanded from role list to attribute-driven delegation to support multi-tenant operator scenarios (added on 2025-03-14).
KMS requirement updated to include HSM attestation path after legal asked for FIPS-level proof (2025-03-17).
decisions: Decision 2025-03-12: Freshness window default set to 120s; config overridable per-customer with minimum 60s.
Decision 2025-03-15: Use SHA-256 HMAC of assertion + nonce as fast inline uniqueness check; will be logged in audit index.
Decision 2025-03-18: Evidence bundle format will be JSONL with per-event canonical fields to simplify ingestion by customer SIEMs.
signoff_checklist: PM signoff: PRD updated and stakeholders notified (Aisha).
Security review: threat model reviewed and mitigations accepted (sec-2025-0319).
Engineering readiness: e2e tests green on dedicated infra and scale harness (QA-run-2025-03-19).
SE/Onboarding signoff: automated evidence generation validated by two demo customers.
Legal/compliance: HSM attestation language approved for export.
test_plan: Unit tests for assertion validation rules (nonce, iat, exp, audience).
Synthetic collision test: generate 1M assertions across 10 nodes and measure uniqueness metric.
Fuzzing SAML test vectors targeting attribute tampering and timestamp manipulation.
Integration test: end-to-end private deploy with customer-managed KMS import path and HSM attestation flow.
Audit ingestion: verify JSONL evidence bundles are parsable and importable into a SIEM stub.
review_comments: 2025-03-13 - Security: Recommend logging masked assertion IDs rather than full assertions to reduce exposure (comment by Idris Chen).
2025-03-16 - Engineering: Need fallback for customers that can't provide HSM attestation; proposed escrow flow documented (comment by Linh Tran).
2025-03-19 - SE: Automated evidence zip must include human-readable summary for pre-sales audits (comment by Priya Nair).
